checks.a_analysis: The source document is a tracked-changes draft that uses red text, underlines (to indicate additions), and strikethroughs (to indicate deletions). The HTML output fails to render the strikethrough formatting. This results in deleted text being presented as active content, which fundamentally changes the visual meaning and intent of the document. For instance, in item (ii), the deleted word 'for' and the added word 'of' are merged into 'forof' without any visual distinction. Additionally, an entire paragraph in section (d)(ii) that is struck through in the source PDF is rendered as normal text in the HTML, incorrectly implying it is part of the current policy.

checks.b_evidence_location: Item (ii) on PDF page 1; Paragraph in section (d)(ii) on PDF page 3.
